description.content: Make an reality check and complete the app to make it more realistic:

details.content:
Global corrections:
- Sum of all servers input/output = global output (network)
- Sum of all servers cpu usage = global cpu usage (should be there)

Server corrections:
- Sum of all containers cpu usage = servers cpu usage
- Sum of all containers memory = servers memory usage
- Sum of all containers input/output = server input/output

Container corrections:
- has own cpu usage in % (of server cpu)
- has own mem usage in Mb (mem of server)
- complete all states: running, paused, starting, stopped, killed
- container has input/output (network)
- Detail View of container with:
  - IP, ENV Variables, Mounted Volumes, Image, processes-list (usually 1-15)
